description: PDFio before 1.6.5 contains an integer underflow in _pdfioCryptoAESDecrypt() in pdfio-aes.c, which strips PKCS#7 padding before any AES block has been decrypted when an AES-encrypted string or binary value holds only its 16-byte IV. Attackers can supply a crafted AES-encrypted PDF that, when opened with pdfioFileOpen(), makes the decrypted length underflow so that _pdfioValueDecrypt() reads and writes out of bounds, crashing the application or corrupting heap memory.
